summary: Read ordered-membership keyset rows and authoritative collection state in one short store transaction

replay.detail: Existing repair and rebuild paths advance a local projection generation, including maintenance at an unchanged claim index.

schema.detail: The local generation uses the existing metadata table; no replicated schema or migration changes.

rules.detail: Membership visibility, admission and checkpoint authority are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The additive store page includes rows, live count, invalidation index, projection generation and read index. Existing HTTP cursors and stream frames are unchanged; no capability is advertised.

recovery.detail: Each page releases its read transaction on return. The generation is transactional and persists across reopen; serving-daemon boot identity remains the API layer's responsibility.
